pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Enchanté' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. Mrs, Madam
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. yes

2. What does 'entre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. in
   C. behind
   D. between

3. What does 'la fenêtre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cat
   B. the book
   C. the window
   D. the bed

4. Fill in: Le chat est ______ la chaise. (under) (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. sous
   C. entre
   D. devant

5. What does 'vendredi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Friday
   C. Monday
   D. Tuesday

6. What number is 'trente et un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 31
   C. 5
   D. 17

7. What does 'le thé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tea
   B. the cake
   C. rice
   D. the banana

8. What does 'le dos' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the hand
   B. the back
   C. the eyes
   D. the foot

9. How do you say 'Turn right.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   B. Elle est sous la chaise.
   C. Tournez à droite.
   D. Où est la clé ?

10. What does 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The ball is behind the door.
   B. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   C. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   D. There is a sofa in the living room.

11. What does 'C'est un lit.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my house.
   B. The ball is behind the door.
   C. It is a table.
   D. It is a bed.

12. What does 'Mets le livre sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The ball is behind the door.
   B. Put the book on the table.
   C. It is a table.
   D. The bag is in the bedroom.

13. What does 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. It is a banana.
   C. I drink a juice.
   D. I do not like fish.

14. What does 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has long hair.
   B. He is tall.
   C. Touch your nose!
   D. She is short.

15. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: How many eyes does Amina have? (1 mark)
   A. three
   B. two
   C. four
   D. one

16. What does 'Il y a un orage.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold.
   B. There is a storm.
   C. It is sunny.
   D. I stay in the house.

17. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is sunny.
   B. There is a storm.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. It is windy.

18. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'father'? (1 mark)
   A. pére
   B. père
   C. pèe
   D. pere

19. How do you say 'the fridge' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le frigo
   B. le livre
   C. le ballon
   D. la fenêtre

20. How do you say 'the ball' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chaise
   B. la chambre
   C. le ballon
   D. le canapé

21. How do you say 'the cat' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le chat
   B. la porte
   C. le livre
   D. la cuisine

22. How do you say 'today' in French? (1 mark)
   A. aujourd'hui
   B. hier
   C. demain
   D. je me repose

23. How do you say 'Tuesday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mardi
   B. samedi
   C. lundi
   D. mercredi

24. Fill in: Cher Kamau, ______ anniversaire ! (1 mark)
   A. Salut
   B. Bonsoir
   C. Bonne
   D. Bon

25. How do you write the number 13 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente
   B. sept
   C. treize
   D. six

26. How do you say the month 'September' in French? (1 mark)
   A. janvier
   B. novembre
   C. août
   D. septembre

27. How do you say 'maize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les bonbons
   B. les frites
   C. la mangue
   D. le maïs

28. How do you say 'the ear' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. la dent
   C. le nez
   D. l'oreille

29. How do you say 'It is windy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du vent.
   B. Il gèle.
   C. Il fait beau.
   D. Il y a des nuages.

30. How do you say 'near' in French? (1 mark)
   A. tout droit
   B. près de
   C. à droite
   D. à gauche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write yesterday, today and tomorrow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'It is a table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'I have a mouth.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

36. Write the months from juillet to décembre in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Write the French words for: Put, behind, under (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Read the poem line: Lundi, mardi, mercredi. Write the three days that follow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Write the French words for: maize, vegetables, juice (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Write a five-line greeting card to a friend called Kamau in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

41. Translate into French: 'He is tall.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'My father is called David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'I do not like fish.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Le jeudi, je chante.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Je reste dans la maison.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
